title: Reverse Thinking
simplified_paragraphs: 有个人向哈桑借了2000元，并且写了借据。在还钱的期限快到的时候，哈桑突然发现借据丢了，这使他非常焦急！因为他知道，丢了借据，向他借钱的这个人是会赖账的。
哈桑的朋友知道此事后，对哈桑说：“你给这个人写封信过去，要他到时候把向你借的2500元还给你。”哈桑听了很迷惑：“我丢了借据，要他还2000元都是个问题，怎么还能向他要2500元呢？”尽管哈桑没想明白，但还是照办了。
信寄出以后，哈桑很快收到了回信，借钱的人在信上写道：“我向你借的是2000元钱，不是2500元，到时候就还你。”
这就是逆向思维，逆向思维会让你打开新世界的大门。
traditional_paragraphs: 有個人向哈桑借了2000元，並且寫了借據。在還錢的期限快到的時候，哈桑突然發現借據丟了，這使他非常焦急！因為他知道，丟了借據，向他借錢的這個人是會賴賬的。
哈桑的朋友知道此事後，對哈桑說：“你給這個人寫封信過去，要他到時候把向你借的2500元還給你。”哈桑聽了很迷惑：“我丟了借據，要他還2000元都是個問題，怎麼還能向他要2500元呢？”儘管哈桑沒想明白，但還是照辦了。
信寄出以後，哈桑很快收到了回信，借錢的人在信上寫道：“我向你借的是2000元錢，不是2500元，到時候就還你。”
這就是逆向思維，逆向思維會讓你打開新世界的大門。

english_paragraphs: A man borrowed 2,000 yuan from Hassan and wrote him an IOU. As the repayment date approached, Hassan suddenly discovered that he had lost it. He was very worried, because he knew the man would deny owing him money without the IOU.

When Hassan’s friend heard what had happened, he said, “Write the man a letter asking him to repay the 2,500 yuan he borrowed from you when it’s due.” Hassan was puzzled. “I’ve lost the IOU, so getting him to repay even 2,000 yuan will be a problem. How can I ask for 2,500?” Although he didn’t understand, Hassan followed his friend’s advice.
Soon after sending the letter, Hassan received a reply. The borrower wrote, “I borrowed 2,000 yuan from you, not 2,500. I’ll repay you when it’s due.”
That is reverse thinking. It can open the door to a whole new world.
english_full:
A man borrowed 2,000 yuan from Hassan and wrote him an IOU. As the repayment date approached, Hassan suddenly discovered that he had lost it. He was very worried, because he knew the man would deny owing him money without the IOU.

When Hassan’s friend heard what had happened, he said, “Write the man a letter asking him to repay the 2,500 yuan he borrowed from you when it’s due.” Hassan was puzzled. “I’ve lost the IOU, so getting him to repay even 2,000 yuan will be a problem. How can I ask for 2,500?” Although he didn’t understand, Hassan followed his friend’s advice.

Soon after sending the letter, Hassan received a reply. The borrower wrote, “I borrowed 2,000 yuan from you, not 2,500. I’ll repay you when it’s due.”

That is reverse thinking. It can open the door to a whole new world.
